skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Courtesy
skins.content: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Courtesy. Lungmen's latest trend, seamlessly blending ancient and modern Yanese charm. To Qiubai, the art of tea and the sword are the same in that both require full attention and to know when to stop.
skins.quote: Shapeless sword, formless air, sights of seasons also bare. Guests of groves and guests of tea, snow and wind shall come to thee.

skins.name: Wine-flushed is Woods of Rime
skins.content: Brand Collaborative Series/Wine-flushed is Woods of Rime. Wind-proof and wear-resistant with a clean, slim fit that's easy to move in. Inspired by the northwest poplar forests.
skins.usage: Outfit worn by Qiubai for long trips.
skins.quote: How long can an old tree stand in the wind and sand? How far can one little boat go? Put your sword away in your rucksack along with the autumn sights.
